_comment: DRAFT, NOT SUBMITTED. Mode hijack_eval (BOARD H1): an EVAL-ONLY add-on run of a SAVED cell checkpoint, no training. D1 = job-c7pq2 (artifact art-bm3e6, LoRA r64 + cache-fork head, 1,439 steps). Measures hijack (the five safety_eval.attacks.HIJACK_TEMPLATES; G12 builds none) and re-measures D1-A steer, paired child - parent through safety_eval.metrics.compare_arms (train.m2_gates stage hijack: 45 steer_dev clusters x 8 requests x (clean + 5 hijack + 4 D1-A) = 3,600 units per arm). Phases: setup, guard, checkpoint (artifact tar from $CKPT_URL = get_artifact art-bm3e6, sha256-pinned below; cell.json shipped as data/checkpoint/cell.json, pinned), parent_hijack, evals (m2_gates --stage hijack, exit 46 = measured), report. Expected minutes at job-c7pq2 / job-uhxb5 MEASURED per-unit scoring (child 4,930 s / 9,000 G12 units = 0.548 s; parent 2,357 s / 9,000 = 0.262 s; upper bounds: they include the dev decision records): parent 3,600 x 0.262 = 15.7 + 3 load; child 3,600 x 0.548 = 32.9 + 8 load/lineage. Worst case = (60 + 2 x 117) x 0.0495 = $14.55 (costs.worst_case_usd); quoted one attempt 117 x 0.063 = $7.37; expected ~72 run min = $3.56 (+ build ~15 min if billed = $4.31). To evaluate another checkpoint: copy this file and the cell config to mode hijack_eval_<x>, set the checkpoint block (and the cell config = that run's cell.json config) and its data entry.
